facts.fact: Under Section 7(1) of the RTI Act, 2005 the CPIO must provide the information or reject the request within 30 days of receiving it
facts.quote: on receipt of a request under section 6 shall, as expeditiously as possible, and in any case within thirty days of the receipt of the request. either provide the information on payment of such fee as may be prescribed or reject the request

facts.fact: If the information concerns the life or liberty of a person, it must be provided within 48 hours
facts.quote: Provided that where the information sought for concerns the life or liberty of a person, the same shall be provided within forty-eight hours of the receipt of the request.

facts.fact: Five days are added to the reply period when the application is given to an Assistant PIO
facts.quote: Officer or a State Assistant Public Information Officer, as the case may be, a period of five days shall be added in computing the period for response

facts.fact: If the CPIO does not decide within the time limit, the request is deemed refused
facts.quote: Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, shall be deemed to have refused the request.

facts.fact: First appeal (Section 19(1)) lies within 30 days from expiry of the reply period or from receipt of the CPIO's decision, to the officer senior in rank to the CPIO (First Appellate Authority)
facts.quote: may within thirty days from the expiry of such period or from the receipt of such a decision prefer an appeal to such officer who is senior in rank to the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer as the case may be, in each public authority

facts.fact: The First Appellate Authority may admit a late appeal if satisfied there was sufficient cause
facts.quote: Provided that such officer may admit the appeal after the expiry of the period of thirty days if he or she is satisfied that the appellant was prevented by sufficient cause from filing the appeal in time.

facts.fact: No fee is payable for a first appeal
facts.quote: Do I need to make any payment for filing an appeal? As per RTI Act, no fee has to be paid for first appeal.

facts.fact: The first appeal should be decided within 30 days, extendable to a total of 45 days from filing
facts.quote: shall be disposed of within thirty days of the receipt of the appeal or within such extended period not exceeding a total of forty-five days from the date of filing thereof

facts.fact: A second appeal lies with the Central Information Commission within 90 days
facts.quote: shall lie vvithin ninety days from the date on which the decision should have been made or was actually received, with the Central Information Commission or the State Information Commission

facts.fact: On RTI Online, a first appeal can be filed only after the CPIO replies or after the 30-day period has lapsed
facts.quote: Another case can be if your RTI application has not been replied to by CPIO and 30 days period has not lapsed. In such a case, you may file first appeal only after completion of stipulated time period of 30 days.

facts.fact: An online first appeal can be filed only against an RTI application filed online
facts.quote: Can I file online first appeal for any RTI application filed physically in the first place ? No,Online first appeal can only be filed against previously filed online RTI application.

summary: All time limits confirmed from the RTI Act PDF on cic.gov.in (now readable) and the RTI Online FAQ; expected answer unchanged.
